name: EDGAR-CORPUS (companion dataset to edgar-crawler)
what_it_holds: https://huggingface.co/datasets/eloukas/edgar-corpus and Zenodo mirror: 1993-2020 annual-report (10-K) text, ~176,289 train + validation/test splits (~220k total filings), fields = filename/CIK/year plus 23 structured sections (Item 1 through 9B incl. 1A/1B/7A/9A/9B), 40.7GB total, per-year configs available (year_1993...year_2020).
why_useful: Large pre-extracted MD&A/risk-factor text corpus across all EDGAR filers (would include BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT annual reports pre-2021) for building a management-tone or peer-commentary time series without re-scraping EDGAR.
duplicate_of_holding: none directly; complements EDGAR-CORPUS entry above
last_activity: dataset released alongside 2021 paper, cited through 2025
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Large pre-extracted MD&A/risk-factor text corpus across all EDGAR filers (would include BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT annual reports pre-2021) for building a management-tone or peer-commentary time series without re-scraping EDGAR.

name: python-edgar
what_it_holds: Stitches EDGAR quarterly full-index files (company name, CIK, filing date, form type, URL) into one master index spanning 1993-present; zero dependencies, MIT, 48 commits (last visible activity ~2018, since forked/maintained by others).
why_useful: Lightweight way to build a master filing-date index for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/ABNB (all form types, all years) to drive point-in-time filing-date joins for the vintage register.
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Lightweight way to build a master filing-date index for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/ABNB (all form types, all years) to drive point-in-time filing-date joins for the vintage register.

name: sec-edgar-downloader
what_it_holds: Python package to bulk-download any SEC filing type (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, 13F, DEF 14A, S-1, SC 13D/G, 300+ types) by ticker or CIK; no bundled data, pulls live from EDGAR. MIT, 212 commits.
why_useful: Straightforward bulk downloader to grab every 8-K/10-Q for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT for a peer-print KPI extraction pipeline.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps edgartools/datamule/python-edgar functionally; include for completeness/reliability comparison
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Straightforward bulk downloader to grab every 8-K/10-Q for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT for a peer-print KPI extraction pipeline.

name: sec-api-python (sec-api.io SDK)
what_it_holds: Python SDK for the sec-api.io service: full-text search over filings from 2001+, XBRL-to-JSON converter for full US GAAP taxonomy (income statement/balance sheet/cash flow), covers 20M+ EDGAR filings/100M+ exhibits since 1993. MIT license for the client; underlying API requires a free API key (rate-limited free tier) or paid plan for volume.
why_useful: Full-text search across all peer 8-Ks/10-Qs (e.g. searching 'RevPAR' or 'nights booked' phrases in filings 2001+) would be a fast way to build a peer KPI-mention index; the free tier may be enough for spot pulls without becoming a paid dependency (CLAUDE.md forbids paid keys as data source, so flag as method-only, do not adopt for the harness).
license: MIT (client); underlying API has free-tier + paid

name: datamule-python
what_it_holds: Python package for bulk SEC filing retrieval (10-K, Form 4, etc.) by ticker; free tier rate-limited to ~5 req/s directly against EDGAR, optional paid 'datamule' hosted archive ($1/100k downloads) for higher throughput. MIT, 673 commits, 557 stars.
why_useful: Alternative bulk-download client for building the peer 8-K/10-Q corpus at scale without hitting SEC's own rate limits as hard; free-tier path stays within our paid-key-free rule.
